requirements: Every occurrence and receipt has a unique ID and immutable dependency edges
Crystal material, termination and orientation cannot be inferred from schematic color
Prepared input requires independent ancestry and earns no fabrication credit
Module/circuit/mount change invalidates dependent calibration and observations
Sweep direction and initialization persist through custody and matching changes
JPA state, reference plane and filter change invalidate paired comparisons
Field/thermal/time records must be paired with each readout
Failed attempts and damaged samples remain archived; replacement gets a new ID
Synthetic bookkeeping is not service authentication or scientific evidence
Same physical STO varactor IDs persist from SQD to DQD while device/module/circuit/calibration revisions change; sweep history persists
